title: Engagement rate from the totals row
path: Reports > Life cycle > Acquisition > Traffic acquisition
steps: In the Google Merchandise Store property, open Reports > Life cycle > Acquisition > Traffic acquisition.
Set the date range to the month the app shows, from its first day to its last.
Read the totals row at the top of the table: Sessions, Engaged sessions and Engagement rate.

parts.label: Sessions
parts.question: How many sessions does the totals row show?

parts.label: Engaged sessions
parts.question: How many engaged sessions does the totals row show?

parts.label: Engagement rate
parts.question: What engagement rate does the totals row show?
On default settings, which rule does GA4 use to count a session as engaged?
options: All three: longer than 10 seconds, a key event, and 2 or more page or screen views
Only that it is not a single-page session
Any one of: longer than 10 seconds, a key event, or 2 or more page or screen views
Any one of: longer than 60 seconds, a scroll event, or a file download
